origin.origins_apocalypse.humano.name: Human
origin.origins_apocalypse.humano.descrip: An ordinary human doesn't change a thing, you idiot.
origin.origins_apocalypse.alien.name: Alien
origin.origins_apocalypse.alien.descript: Beings from another planet, when they came to explore ours out of curiosity, were knocked out by gravity.
power.origins_apocalypse.size_alien.name: Chikiriro
power.origins_apocalypse.size_alien.desc: Our planet's gravity has left you short; you're now 1 block tall.
origin.origins_apocalypse.elfo.name: Elf
origin.origins_apocalypse.elfo.descripti: An incredibly long-lived breed, it can live for centuries.
power.origins_apocalypse.size_elfo.name: Tall
power.origins_apocalypse.size_elfo.descr: Your longevity makes you taller. You are 1.5 blocks tall.
origin.origins_apocalypse.orco.name: Orc
origin.origins_apocalypse.orco.descripti: Not very smart, green, and grumpy beings.
power.origins_apocalypse.size_orco.name: Corpulent
power.origins_apocalypse.size_orco.descr: A huge mole: 3 high and 2 wide.
origin.origins_apocalypse.enano.name: Dwarf
origin.origins_apocalypse.enano.descript: A race almost as long-lived as elves.
power.origins_apocalypse.size_enano.name: Fun-sized
power.origins_apocalypse.size_enano.desc: Short, but of broad and robust build.
You have survived, although you don't quite know how.
origin.origins_apocalypse.titan.name: Titan
origin.origins_apocalypse.titan.descript: A mountain of muscle and brute force. Impossible to ignore.
power.origins_apocalypse.titan_furia.des: The more wounded you are, the stronger you become: you gain Strength and Resistance below 75%, 50% and 25% health.
power.origins_apocalypse.titan_punos.des: Your bare-handed punches deal as much damage as a stone sword.
power.origins_apocalypse.titan_hambre.de: Your massive body burns through food faster.
origin.origins_apocalypse.quimera.name: Chimera
origin.origins_apocalypse.quimera.descri: The result of an experiment that should never have survived... and yet, here it is.
origin.origins_apocalypse.cerebrito.name: Brainiac
origin.origins_apocalypse.cerebrito.desc: No strength, but something far more dangerous: they know exactly what they're doing.
power.origin.origins_apocalypse.cerebrit: Your body is weak, so you have 2 fewer hearts.
origin.origins_apocalypse.corrompido.des: Between the living and the dead. They belong to neither side anymore.
power.origins_apocalypse.corruption.name: Corruption
power.origins_apocalypse.corruption.desc: A bar that slowly fills on its own. At 25% you gain Speed III, at 50% Night vision and at 75% Resistance III. If it fills completely, poison leaves you one step from death. Resets on death.
power.origins_apocalypse.carronero.name: Scavenger
power.origins_apocalypse.carronero.descr: You eat rotten flesh without suffering its effects.
origin.origins_apocalypse.cypollorg.name: Cypollorg
origin.origins_apocalypse.cypollorg.desc: Enhanced soldiers with implants, you are 50% human and 50% machine.
Water damages your circuits: it harms you while you're in it.
